text:
sasha: Quick commuter poll — two options for my 25-minute ride this week: a tight 20–30m playlist to get me hyped, or a single short audiobook/novella chapter to actually feel like I read something. Any fresh recs? :coffee:

omar: playlist for me 99% of the time. rec: 'Sunrise Guitar' — mellow indie/folk 25m. spotify:playlist:37i9dQZF1DX8w7c3q9f3G4 (works well on loop) :guitar:

jules: novella vote here. If you want something that fits one ride, try the short audiobook of "The Yellow Wallpaper" readings — intense but quick. Also, LeVar Burton does great 15–20m reads.

anya: I alternate. For walking commutes I do a single short story episode — currently on a flash fiction podcast called "15 Minute Fiction". Perfect bite-sized narrative and keeps me entertained without losing the plot at work.

mike: If you go playlists, consider a slightly longer album that still fits: Tycho — Awake is ~45m but you can stop halfway and it still feels complete. For true 25m try the EP "Sunlit" by Morning Wave.

sasha: Nice recs. Anyone have something very narrative-driven but under 20m? I want to feel like I consumed a whole story, not just an excerpt.

omar: Short story podcasts: "Flash Fiction" usually has 7–12m episodes. Found a couple of gems there.

jules: Also check out the BBC "Short Reads" series — well produced, often 10–18m.

anya: vote: :thumbsup: playlist, :books: short story. (not an actual poll, just vibes)

mike: added a quick playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX8w7c3q9f3G4 (Sunrise Guitar) — dropped into the #commute-shared-playlist.

spotify-bot: Added 1 track to #commute-shared-playlist on behalf of mike.

sasha: Thank you all — saving these! Will try the LeVar one tomorrow morning and report back. :sparkles:
